name: minimail-mcp
description: Multi-service email platform supporting SMTP/IMAP, SendGrid, Mailgun, Resend, local testing, webhook integrations, draft management, and AI-assisted writing

smtp_password.title: SMTP Password/App Password
smtp_password.description: Password or App Password for SMTP authentication

imap_password.title: IMAP Password/App Password
imap_password.description: Password or App Password for IMAP authentication

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send emails via multiple service types (SMTP, API, webhook)

tools.name: check_inbox
tools.description: Check inbox via IMAP or service-specific APIs

tools.name: fetch_email_detail
tools.description: Fetch a single email by ID with full text and HTML body

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Full-text IMAP search across subject and body

tools.name: delete_email
tools.description: Delete/move-to-trash a single email via IMAP

tools.name: mark_email_read
tools.description: Mark a single email as read (SEEN flag)

tools.name: email_status
tools.description: Get server configuration and connectivity status

tools.name: configure_service
tools.description: Configure different email services dynamically at runtime

tools.name: remove_service
tools.description: Remove a dynamically configured email service

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List available and configured email services

tools.name: email_help
tools.description: Get help and documentation for email operations

tools.name: mailing_lists_catalog
tools.description: List named mailing-list presets from EMAIL_MCP_MAILING_LISTS

tools.name: mailing_list_latest
tools.description: Fetch newest messages for a named mailing-list preset

tools.description: Suggest 1-3 email subject lines via MCP sampling
